title: Outdoor Smoked Peruvian Beef Skewers
description: Smoky and chewy Peruvian beef skewers featuring ground nut oil and a blend of Mediterranean spices, smoked to perfection over an outdoor grill.
instructions: Preheat the outdoor grill to 400 degrees Fahrenheit, preparing for smoking.
In a large bowl, combine the ground beef, ground nut oil, smoked paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, black pepper, cumin, and chili flakes, mixing well with your hands until just combined.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for 30 minutes to allow the flavors to meld.
Thread the beef mixture onto the soaked bamboo skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Place the skewers on the grill, close the lid, and smoke for 10-12 minutes, or until the internal temperature reaches 160 degrees Fahrenheit.
Flip the skewers and continue to smoke for an additional 5-7 minutes, or until the internal temperature reaches 165 degrees Fahrenheit.
Remove the skewers from the grill and let rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Serve the skewers hot, garnished with fresh parsley or cilantro if desired.
